mapper.select: SELECT dvt.* FROM( SELECT a.id, a.api_code, a.local_id, a.sha256_code_list, STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() over ( PARTITION BY sha256_code_list ORDER BY id DESC ) AS rn FROM b_xiecheng_sms_colliding_data_vt a ) dvt LEFT JOIN b_xiecheng_sms_colliding_data_log_vt dlvt ON dvt.sha256_code_list = dlvt.sha256_code_list AND dlvt.send_date = #{sendDate} WHERE dvt.STATUS = 1 AND dvt.rn=1 AND dvt.local_id = #{localId} AND ( dlvt.id IS NULL) ORDER BY dvt.id ASC LIMIT 15000;
